name: BIOLLANTE
about: The C example BIOLLANTE rebuilt in blocks and taken deeper (PAD-658): six Left ramps start her (12 the second time, 18 the third) and every shot feeds the SAP JACKPOT. Four stages: THE ROSE (cut the Shield and Powerline vine banks to collect the sap x1, x2 into the pot), ROSE ABLAZE (burn the lit petal as Godzilla's ray moves across the ramps and the Big loop), REGROWTH (cut all six vines while she grows them back), then her BEAST form: the final blow at the Building, the pot twice over. 40 s a stage; the line names the shots (SHIELDS: 2 TO GO  POWERLINES: 3 TO GO, SHOOT THE BIG LOOP). Cash the pot out at the right scoop after any stage; the clock or a drain pays a quarter.
lost: Every stage has 40 s, the beast's too (PAD-658's round 3: time to do it): round 2 gave the beast 20 s, and she grew a vine back after 6 s alone (5 s, 4 s the more she had been fought), now after 20 s.

A new stage is named by the HUD's title (ROSE ABLAZE, REGROWTH, BIOLLANTE BEAST), not by a note over the one the stage before ended on (THE ROSE IS CUT, THE ROSE IS ABLAZE, THE VINES ARE DOWN): that note stays its 3 s and says what comes next; the beast's BEAST FORM! note is gone.
On Godzilla Pro the line names the shield bank SHIELDS+GODZILLA (its two shields and the Godzilla target between them: title_alt's words).
Only the port's named shots feed the sap: the C scored every playfield switch (its 0x1 switch dispatch), rollovers and other unnamed switches included.
The counters show bare numbers: SAP 500,000 over X1 AT A BANK, where the C showed the bank count as 2/3 and the switch value as 125K.

No VINES gauge: on the glass its pips sat over the game's own POWER widget at the right edge, so the vines are counted on the third counter in the regrowth (the C showed six pips shaded green to rose, BEAST in the beast form).
The ramp count note reads RAMPS TO BIOLLANTE over 3  -  SHOOT THE LEFT RAMP (the number under the words) where the C said 5 RAMPS TO BIOLLANTE.
The shield vines light at once: the C lit them only once the shield platform had turned to face the player.
A vine's clip plays at most once in each 4 s window of the mode's own (a block's every 4 seconds): the C waited 4 s from the last one it played.

No randomness in blocks: Godzilla's ray burns her petals in a fixed order (Left ramp, Big loop, Right ramp) and she grows back the first vine cut in a fixed order (the shields left to right, then the powerlines).
The beast's Building blink quickens against its 40 s clock (slow, then fast in its last 13 s), where the C quickened it across the beast's own 20 s.

The ending (BIOLLANTE IS FREE, BIOLLANTE RETREATS or BIOLLANTE WITHERS, its line and the total) stays up 3 s, the runtime's: the C kept it 10 s; its SWITCHES are the named shots made (the C counted every switch).
No debounce: the C counted the same target once in 250 ms (a bouncing standup pays once); the blocks count every report.
A hit no longer answers by itself: the C flashed every scoring shot's inserts white and played the game's climbing orchestra hit (PAD-415).
Its ending call plays after one of the game's own modes ends it too (the C kept quiet then, as it does for a drain or a tilt).

On Godzilla Pro the shield bank is the left shield, the Godzilla target and the right shield (the Pro has two fixed shields), and the start plays the Pro's Wide yellow and white strobe: the C's bank there was the two shields alone.

intro.what: 0:34:19.4, the camera tilts up across Lake Ashi to reveal Biollante's rose form standing in the misty, glowing lake, one shot.

loop.what: 0:34:27, a slow low-angle tilt up Biollante's rose-form stalk and leaves to the closed red rose head, vines gently swaying, one continuous shot.

cut.what: 0:55:10, at night on the lake Godzilla's ray strikes a vine reaching out from Biollante and the vine bursts into smoke, one shot.

collect.what: 0:54:55, a run of two shots: a vine mouth sprays yellow sap into Godzilla's face, then Godzilla's head steams with it.

beast.what: 1:31:19, a run of two shots: extreme close-ups of the beast form's huge tooth-lined jaws, then the jaws opening on the red mouth, under lightning flashes.

won.what: 1:36:13, Biollante's beast form dissolves into a glowing pink cloud of spores that drift upward, one shot.

lost.what: 1:33:55, a run of two shots: Biollante's beast jaws close on Godzilla's head, then a close-up of the jaws clamped on him.

ablaze.what: A run of three shots: Godzilla's ray strikes Biollante's rose-form stalk in fiery orange bursts, smoke rolls over the lake, then his blue ray pours into the blazing rose, at 0:55:52.

burn.what: Close on Biollante's red rose head engulfed in roaring orange flames, the petals showing through the fire, at 0:56:02.

grab.what: At night on Lake Ashi Biollante's vines whip across and coil round the head of a roaring Godzilla, at 0:52:54.

cashout.what: A column of glittering golden spores rises from the burnt rose into the dark sky as the last flames flicker, at 0:56:43.

music.what: 1:42:08.682, Koichi Sugiyama's Super X2 march as reprised in the end credits (the same passage the earlier bed took at 0:43:05 under the Super X2 launch), orchestra only, no dialogue or effects.

cut.what: 1:09:00, a short, clean Godzilla roar during the Osaka attack, from its onset until it falls away at 1:09:02.

collect.what: 0:54:55, the wet burst of Biollante's sap spraying from a vine mouth into Godzilla's face and the first hiss of it burning, ending at a dip.

beast.what: 1:30:59.9, Biollante's beast-form roar as she rises at night, a falling screech into a deep growl.

won.what: 1:36:14.4, Biollante's soft, eerie dying cry, a falling wail that settles and fades as she turns to spores, over a quiet score.

lost.what: 1:32:49, Godzilla's pained roar as Biollante's vine mouths bite into his hands, ending as it falls away.

ablaze.what: Godzilla's ray fires with a sudden roaring hiss and blasts into Biollante across the lake, ending where the shot cuts away, at 0:55:27.6.

grab.what: Biollante's eerie whistling cry, a high glide that falls away, as a vine mouth lunges at Godzilla, at 1:31:48.6.

cashout.what: A soft, eerie wail from Biollante as her shape melts into the glowing pink spore cloud, fading to quiet, at 1:36:11.2.

beast.what: The film's own driving military battle march, steady brass chords over a pulsing orchestra, under the wireframe battle-plan display before the final battle, at 1:23:54.8.
